annotation.summary_en: A reporter tries to interview a 120-year-old man in Tibet about his longevity, only for the old man to agree with every contradiction the reporter throws at him.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place on a rocky mountainside in Tibet. A frustrated reporter and his cameraman, Ashot, are looking for a 'normal' story, despite the reporter's ironic claim that a 120-year-old man is inherently 'abnormal' because normal people die at 80. They encounter Nerses, an old man dressed in mystical robes and smoking a pipe. The reporter introduces his show, 'Tsibet Tsibet,' and begins interviewing Nerses about his longevity. Nerses reveals he has smoked and drank heavily his whole life, and lived a wild lifestyle involving many women in Gelendzhik. The reporter, fearing the report is losing its educational value, stops the filming to coach Nerses into providing a 'virtuous' reason for his long life. They restart, and Nerses claims his secret is that he never argues with anyone. When the reporter immediately argues that such a feat is impossible, Nerses instantly agrees with him, saying 'You're right, it is impossible,' completely undermining the premise of his own 'secret.'
catchphrases: Պուծինը ընդե սաղին հանելա գործից չենք կարա իրան գնանք նկարենք
ծիբետ ծիբետ օ ինչ լավն ես ծիբետ
40 տարի առաջ գնացի Գելենջիկ օրը 4 հատ աղջիկ էինք ստորացնում
ես ընդհանրապես ոչ մեկի հետ չեմ վիճում
